description: This file defines the TaxClass entity for the sales management system, mapping to the TAX_CLASS database table. It includes fields such as id, code, title, associated products, merchant store, and tax rates, along with relevant JPA annotations for ORM and relationships.

classes.name: TaxClass
classes.description: Represents a tax classification used for categorizing tax rates applicable to products, linked to a merchant store and containing multiple tax rates.

methods.name: TaxClass()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a TaxClass instance with a provided code, setting the title to the same value.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the TaxClass.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the TaxClass.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Gets the title of the tax class.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the tax class.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code associated with the tax class.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code for the tax class.

methods.name: getTaxRates
methods.description: Retrieves the list of tax rates associated with this tax class.

methods.name: setTaxRates
methods.description: Sets the list of tax rates for this tax class.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Retrieves the merchant store associated with this tax class.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with this tax class.
